status: Illustrative full-liquid phase calculations; not a valve-event or gas solver

provenance.geometry_and_path_losses: Previous illustrative 50 mm piston and outlet path; identical inlet path assumed here. No component calibration. Additional linear resistance is omitted, not proved negligible.
provenance.systemic_R1: Illustrative 0.04 mmHg s/mL; close to 53 dyn s/cm^5 = 0.03975 mmHg s/mL in Nichols et al. 1977 group A. Not a fitted rig coefficient.
provenance.pulmonary_R1: Illustrative 0.015 mmHg s/mL; informed by Qureshi et al. 2018 Table 2, Dataset 1. Not a fitted rig coefficient.
provenance.R2: Chosen so periodic mean arterial pressures are 90 mmHg systemic and 15 mmHg pulmonary at 5 L/min with the stated return pressures. Mean agreement is imposed by this choice, not independent corroboration.
provenance.C_and_reservoir_pressures: Free illustrative engineering inputs, not identified patient values. No pressure-waveform fitting performed.
provenance.heart_reference: Qureshi et al. 2018 author manuscript Appendix A Table A1, Dataset 1; functional human arterial reference reproduced from Milnor 1989. 75 bpm, 6.6 L/min. Original acquisition/raw clinical recording not inspected. Reference waveforms remain unscaled.
